candidate.definition_en: To emphasize something or make people notice it.
candidate.explanation_ar: يبرز أهمية حاجة أو يعلم عليها بقلم فسفوري عشان تبان.

senses.definition_en: To emphasize something or make people notice it.
senses.definition_ar: يسلط الضوء على شيء أو يبرز أهميته للفت الانتباه إليه.
examples: We want to highlight the main benefits of this new program.
The conference aims to highlight the challenges facing public education.

senses.definition_en: To mark text with a bright colour to make it stand out.
senses.definition_ar: يعلم على نص بلون مميز لتمييزه وتسهيل قراءته.
examples: Please highlight the correct answer on your worksheet.
Please highlight the correct answer on your worksheet.
We want to highlight the main benefits of this new program.
The conference aims to highlight the challenges facing public education.
candidate.mnemonic: بتخلي الحاجة 'High' في الأهمية لما تحط عليها 'Light'.
